summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Guardian Metal Resources PLC, a foreign private issuer, announcing a pre-feasibility study update for its Pilot Mountain Tungsten Project and an upcoming investor presentation. The filing does not involve any M&A, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation transaction. It is a routine operational update that does not require classification under any special-situations category. The document is a press release and investor presentation notice, which is a standard current report with no change in control or strategic event.
